findings.description: One entry per distinct problem the change introduces; empty when there is none.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root, as in the diff.

start_line.description: First line of the problem, counted from 1, in the reviewed version of the file.

end_line.description: Last line of the problem; equal to start_line for a single line.

message.description: What is wrong, why it matters and how to fix it.
